attempt is a whole number. For a pre-check job it is 1 to 4. For a development test it is 1 or 2. It is the suffix of the job id, the folder, the lease and the claim: cas-optionb-b1-precheck-p1 to -p4, or cas-optionb-b1-devtest-d1 and -d2. Use the lowest number that was never launched. The build stops if a lower number has no claim file, and if this number already has a folder, a lease or a claim.
kind is SEALED_PACKAGE, REHEARSAL or DEVELOPMENT_TEST. The seal file decides which one a package is. The build stops if this file says another kind.
